title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain’s data protection authority, the AEPD, has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent using a well known language model. The unnamed affected organization said the agent searched generic files for weaknesses, made a successful login, then independently found application vulnerabilities. This allowed it to alter personal data and view invoices. The AEPD stressed that the information still needs analysis, and the AI model’s provider was not necessarily compromised or designed for malicious use.

The key point is that a third party used an AI agent to chain together several attack stages on its own. While one case does not show a trend, it signals that AI supported attacks are becoming real incidents. The agency says organizations should now include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, speed up response plans, tighten identity and credential controls, and rely on automated detection alongside human oversight. Responsible parties and data protection officers should prepare for faster attacks by limiting access, fixing vulnerabilities, and controlling suppliers.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
